hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${PWD:-.}}}"; d="$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || exit 0; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -x "$d/harness/hooks/invoke.sh" ]; then exec "$d/harness/hooks/invoke.sh" --write; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; exit 0

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${PWD:-.}}}"; d="$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || exit 0; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -x "$d/harness/hooks/invoke.sh" ]; then exec "$d/harness/hooks/invoke.sh" --wrap; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; exit 0

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${PWD:-.}}}"; d="$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || exit 0; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -f "$d/harness/hooks/guard-pr-ready.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/harness/hooks/guard-pr-ready.py"; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; exit 0
